description: One question by id, open or resolved: the statement, the nulls, Tickerz's answer, the crowd split once answers have closed, the outcome (the first stored Activity score at or after the resolve time; void when none lands within 3 hours) and who was right. proofs[] holds each OpenTimestamps proof: the question's canonical_json at once, each hourly answer batch's once answers close; sha256(canonical_json) equals digest_sha256. Same data as GET /api/questions/{id}.
